name: Dana’s 108 Verified Collection
blurb: Signed copies of Dana Gillespie’s books, each with a limited edition Polaroid bookmark. Every copy is numbered: 108 of each book, with a certificate code anyone can check.

items.title: Weren’t Born a Man
items.blurb: Dana’s own story: Bowie and Dylan, Jimmy Page and Elton John, Mary Magdalene, Mustique and the blues. “Hilarious and moving”, said The Times.

items.title: What Memories We Make
items.blurb: Six decades in photographs, with the stories behind them: Bowie in the Seventies, Mustique, India, the movies and the Temple of Art and Music.
